messages.content: 你能提供關於電影《全面啟動》的簡介，然後再幫我檢索有關同一部電影《全面啟動》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息，以及電影《黑暗騎士》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息嗎？

Or maybe combine Inception brief and extra into one object? The user explicitly says "first provide a brief about Inception, then retrieve extra info for Inception and The Dark Knight." So likely three separate objects.

Thus we need to call function twice? Actually we need to call function three times. But the tool only allows one call per function invocation. We can call it multiple times. We'll do:

2. movie_details_brief(title="Inception", extra_info=true)
